entities.summary: Previously known as NATO Undersea Research Centre (NURC), the Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentation (CMRE) is a scientific research and experimentation NATO facility that organises and conducts scientific research and technology development, centred on the maritime domain, to address defence and security needs of the Alliance. It is an executive body of NATO Science and Technology Organization (STO). It was established in 1959.
